t: The Roughneck Self‑Prying Pry Bar is a robust 10" (254mm) wrecking bar designed for efficient salvage, demolition, and renovation tasks. Its unique self-prying wedge delivers exceptional lifting and separating force, making it ideal for removing floor tiles, planks, and sub-flooring with reduced effort. Constructed from heavy-duty, heat-treated carbon steel with a black powder-coated finish, this tool offers superior durability and is rust and corrosion-resistant. Two integrated nail pullers provide fast fastener removal, while the comfort-grip handle absorbs shock during heavy prying. A ground bevel edge allows clean material separation and can act as a reliable shim for levelling cabinet bases.
b: Built for Tough Prying & Lifting Tasks
